tasks.short: Confer with institutions to develop health standards or programmes.

steps.what: Find and check current approved health standards, programme aims and institutional requirements for the actual discussion
Confer with schools, public authorities or community groups about actual health needs, proposed standards and practical programme constraints
Develop the proposed health programme or standard contribution, specifying actual actions, responsibilities, limits and unresolved issues with the appropriate specialist
outputs: actual programme decisions and draft content

steps.what: Write and check the actual programme discussion document, decisions, disagreements and responsibilities, including its intended internal folder and stakeholder recipient
inputs: actual programme decisions and draft content

steps.what: Save the exact approved programme discussion document v1 to the internal development folder
Send the exact approved programme discussion document v1 to the approved school, authority or community recipient

tasks.design: Configure approved-reference filters and the existing programme document template in {DOCS}. The technician participates in the discussion and develops actual programme content; native headers and layout reduce only repeated document formatting before completed-version checks, separate save and stakeholder send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference navigation and repeated discussion-document formatting can be manual.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document filters and templates can reuse known metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling institutional needs and designing workable health programmes require people.
tasks.human_edge: Understand disagreements and distinguish a proposal from an institution's actual commitment.

ambition.what: No power to adopt a public health standard.

tasks.altitude: Discussion and programme development remain whole; small preparation and formatting work shrinks.

reach.learn: How technical observations become justified programme requirements

evidence.claim: Native document filters and templates can reduce reference navigation and repeated layout without choosing health standards.

assumptions: Boundary includes the technician's consultation, programme contribution and actual written follow-up. Specialist and stakeholder participation remains their own unchanged effort; the technician's participation is fully retained. Shares are provisional.

Standards owners supply current version, topic, source and institutional scope; the technician checks missing or disputed applicability manually in s1/s3. Stakeholders supply actual views during s2, not structured free inputs.

The technician captures actual decisions, actions, owners, limits and disagreements in s3-s4. s4 saves only known headers and layout; substantive drafting and meaning checks remain. Native templates come first and no model is needed for formatting.
s4 approves the completed document and both destinations. Edits void approval. Ordinary saves, actual sends and runtime earn no saving; formal institutional adoption is separate.
unknowns: Actual consultation authority and current reference organisation
research_questions: Which recurring programme-document elements are formatting rather than substantive development?

already_counted.description: Capture, write and check actual discussion and programme content

incremental.description: Maintain programme template and approved-reference links

approvals.approved_version: programme discussion package v1: document and internal folder
programme discussion package v1: document and stakeholder recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 3 lookup plus 2.7 header/layout points less 0.7 upkeep = 5. Low assumes references and layouts are already reused; conference participation and programme development do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect ecological and human-health risk data at brownfield sites.

steps.what: Find and check the actual brownfield site history, approved sampling instructions, target locations and relevant existing risk records
Collect actual brownfield observations, samples and instrument readings under the approved method, recording location, time and field conditions
Enter actual sample identifiers, locations, measurement values and units, collection times, conditions and deviations in the site field record
Check the exact completed site-data packet v1 for sample identity, actual locations, values/units, method deviations, completeness and intended internal site record
Save the exact approved actual site-data packet v1 to the internal brownfield site record

tasks.design: Configure site-specific reference filters in {DOCS} and native field-record headers and unit checks in the environmental field-data system in {OTHER}. The technician still collects actual samples and observations and enters actual values; only reference navigation and repeated headers shrink before full final packet validation and save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site records can be dispersed and field headers repeatedly entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native site filters and validated offline forms can reuse known project information.
tasks.still_hard: Contamination, sample integrity, exposure conditions and ambiguous field observations require actual site work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a collection condition that makes a sample or reading unreliable.

ambition.what: No autonomous risk assessment or remediation decision.

tasks.altitude: Field collection remains whole; small reference and recording work becomes easier.

reach.role: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
reach.learn: Sampling representativeness and how collection uncertainty limits interpretation

evidence.claim: Native site filters and field-form headers can reduce repeated navigation and metadata entry while people capture actual environmental measurements.

assumptions: Boundary is actual site-data collection and its checked internal record, not a completed risk assessment. Sample transport, laboratory testing and any external transfer retain their actual labour and separate authority; no benefit is credited to them. Shares are provisional.

The project specialist supplies approved sampling plan, site ID, target locations, analytes, units and methods; existing site owners supply actual history. Missing metadata or changed field conditions are resolved manually in s1-s2.

The technician produces actual sample IDs, actual coordinates/locations, times, values/units, instrument/method identifiers, conditions and deviations in s2-s3. Planned sample points are never treated as actual samples; no device feed, free scanning or inferred measurements are assumed.

{OTHER} means environmental field-data records. s3 reuses known site headers only, retaining actual capture; s4 checks full actual-data meaning and integrity. Native configuration comes first. Edits void approval, ordinary save is unchanged and runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Existing site metadata and offline field-form support
research_questions: Which repeated project fields can be reused without confusing planned and actual sample locations?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual field-data entries
Validate completed actual sample and observation packet

incremental.description: Maintain site header mappings, reference filters and unit checks

approvals.approved_version: actual site-data packet v1 and site destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 4.5 reference-search plus 3 repeated-header points less 0.8 upkeep = 6.7. Low assumes incomplete site records and bespoke sampling keep most desk work manual; collection and final validation keep full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview people about communicable disease or health-rule evidence.

steps.what: Review the authorised interview scope, existing case evidence and approved disease or health/sanitation questions for the actual case
Conduct the actual interview, clarify communicable-disease or health/sanitation facts, distinguish direct observation from hearsay and handle sensitive questions within the authorised scope
Write and check the actual interview account, source attribution, dates, uncertainties and follow-up needs in the restricted case note
Save the exact checked actual interview note v1 to the authorised restricted case record

tasks.design: Configure case-reference filters and known case-header reuse in the restricted investigation system in {OTHER}. The technician conducts and documents the interview personally; source attribution and actual statements are never inferred from a questionnaire, and the complete checked note has a separate save gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case context may require repeated navigation and header re-entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and restricted record forms can reuse authorised context.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive recall, conflicting accounts and evidence reliability require a human interviewer.
tasks.human_edge: Ask a clarifying question without turning uncertainty into a false fact.

ambition.what: No new disease-investigation or enforcement authority.

tasks.altitude: Interview time stays whole; small preparation and header tasks shrink.

reach.learn: Evidence attribution and limits on the technician's case responsibilities

evidence.claim: Native restricted case views and header reuse can support interview preparation and recording without generating evidence.

assumptions: Boundary includes authorised interview preparation, actual interviewing and the note. The institution must establish appropriate scope and access before collection; no personal medical detail is copied into a general employer performance or absence dashboard. Shares are provisional.

The case owner supplies authorised purpose, case ID, existing evidence and approved guidance. Missing context is checked manually in s1. The technician produces actual account, source attribution, dates and uncertainty in s2-s3, retaining capture and substantive review time.

{OTHER} means restricted health/sanitation investigation records. s3 saves only known header re-entry; no transcript, ambient recording or model-generated evidence is assumed. Native configuration comes first.

s3 approves the completed note and restricted destination; edits void approval. Ordinary save and runtime earn no saving. Any later referral or authority report is its own final-version-gated send and receives no benefit here.
unknowns: Actual investigation authority, restricted access and record fields
research_questions: Can existing case views reduce navigation without widening access to health information?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual attributed interview evidence

incremental.description: Maintain case-reference links and permitted header defaults

approvals.approved_version: actual interview note v1 and restricted case destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 2.5 case-reference plus 1.9 header-entry points less 0.5 upkeep = 3.9. Low assumes existing case views and headers already work; interviewing and substantive evidence writing retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Actual consultation, field collection and interviewing remain central; small reference and record-formatting tasks can shrink.
reach: Occupational Health and Safety Specialists: connect actual technical evidence to justified programme decisions
Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health: understand collection uncertainty
role.ambitious_version: A technician who brings clear, checked observations and actual interview evidence to the specialists responsible for health decisions.
